translations.answer: The original thread and PR #1809 processing involves: first executing sim.reset(), then scene.update(dt=physics_dt), followed by loading managers or reading IMU.data. Placing scene.update() before sim.reset() would access uninitialized articulation data. The version containing PR #1809 has this step included in ManagerBasedEnv and DirectRLEnv initialization; older versions can be reverted in the same order for retesting.
translations.applicability: Original issue corresponds to Isaac Sim 4.2/old IsaacLab main; fix corresponds to version containing PR #1809.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, the environment is clear and free of conflicts, and there is formal documentation or precise independent replication.
translations.details.attempts.0: The community manually added scene.update() during initialization; DirectRLEnv users encountered Articulation._data not found when placing scene.update() before sim.reset(). Swapping the order resolved the issue.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: The initialization call chain was verified to ensure ObservationManager reads data before the first scene.update(); the relative order of scene.update() and sim.reset()/load_managers() was checked.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Call self.scene.update(dt=self.physics_dt) after sim.reset() and before load_managers() or first sensor observation reading; or use the version containing PR #1809.
translations.details.environments.0: Original post: 84b2d2d8849e86752aa5a948d5f818d8430eec5a; Isaac Sim 4.2.0-rc.17; Ubuntu 20.04; RTX A6000; CUDA 11.8; ManagerBasedRLEnv/ANYmal-D; subsequent DirectRLEnv/ANYmal-C retesting.
translations.details.limits.0: The PR #1809 checkbox was not selected; manual regression testing is still required for older branches.
translations.details.outcomes.0: DirectRLEnv users confirmed the corrected order; PR #1809 was merged into the main repository, and the issue was closed with merge commit 157c6b74.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why is the ObservationManager reporting an error when trying to access IMU data before the update?
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The environment initialization was not updated before extracting IMU.data, leading to IMU._dt and other scene buffers not being filled.
translations.details.symptoms.0: ObservationManager accesses asset.data.lin_acc_b during term dimension preparation; IMU._dt is not set, resulting in a RuntimeError: The update function must be called before the data buffers are accessed the first time.
translations.source.locator: Issue #1423 retesting issuecomment-2657349510; merged PR #1809; merged commit 157c6b74
